history_summary.value: The Pedres Portuguesa is a traditional Portuguese dual-purpose breed centred on the Minho region in the north-west of the country. Once considered at risk with only around 4,500 breeding hens in the early 2000s, its population had recovered substantially by 2024 and is no longer considered at risk.
